name: Doom Of The Cracked Shield
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 1, druid/shaman 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one non-magical shield
Duration permanent
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The next wooden or iron shield you hit in combat crumbles into sawdust and rust. Magic shields are immune to this spell.

Alternately, you may employ doom of the cracked shield in combat as a melee touch attack. Doom of the cracked shield used in this way instantaneously destroys 2 points of AC gained from armor, but this effect only works once per opponent, and it ends the spell.

Mythic: By spending a use of mythic power, you make magical shields susceptible to this effect.
